page.overview:
Who is Deku Butler's Son?

The Deku Butler's Son is first mentioned by the Deku Butler after leading Link to the Mask of Scents. The butler apologizes to Link for traveling so fast, stating that Link reminds him of his son whom he used to race with through the Deku Shrine. During the New Day, the Deku Butler is seen mourning the deceased Deku tree seen at the start of the game, which implies that the dead tree is the butler's lost son.
